item.title: Sources: OpenAI has secured ~$11B in commitments for its latest funding round, less than half its initial $30B target, and expects to raise more in coming weeks (Berber Jin/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:

Sources: OpenAI has secured ~$11B in commitments for its latest funding round, less than half its initial $30B target, and expects to raise more in coming weeks  —  The ChatGPT maker's latest funding round values it at $1.25 trillion, less than its $1.4 trillion target

item.title: Sources: Baseten is raising ~$2B in two tranches, one valuing it at $26B and the other at $30B; Baseten was valued at $13B in June after raising $1.5B (Bloomberg)
item.description:
Bloomberg:
Sources: Baseten is raising ~$2B in two tranches, one valuing it at $26B and the other at $30B; Baseten was valued at $13B in June after raising $1.5B  —  Artificial intelligence startup Baseten is set to raise new funding that would more than double its valuation to about $30 billion, according to people familiar with the efforts.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-30/baseten-set-for-30-billion-valuation-with-new-funding

item.title: Filing: Vancouver, WA-based Powerlattice, which makes a power delivery chiplet to reduce AI compute power needs by 50%+, raised $86M, after raising $31M in 2025 (Kurt Schlosser/GeekWire)
item.description:
Kurt Schlosser / GeekWire:
Filing: Vancouver, WA-based Powerlattice, which makes a power delivery chiplet to reduce AI compute power needs by 50%+, raised $86M, after raising $31M in 2025  —  Powerlattice, a Vancouver, Wash.-based startup developing chips that cut the power demands of AI processors, has raised $86 million, according to an SEC filing on Friday.

Original (direct link): https://www.geekwire.com/2026/filing-chip-startup-powerlattice-raises-86m-to-ease-ais-power-crunch/

item.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI across multiple crawlers (Emma Roth/The Verge)
item.description:
Emma Roth / The Verge:
OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI across multiple crawlers  —  The new control will allow publishers to apply their AI training preferences across multiple crawlers.

Original (direct link): https://www.theverge.com/tech/1023763/openai-google-microsoft-ai-scraping-standard-opt-out

item.description:

item.title: Chainalysis says Binance hackers used automated money-laundering patterns not seen before; Elliptic: almost all of the $6.3B was taken in the first 30 minutes (Financial Times)
item.description:
Financial Times:
Chainalysis says Binance hackers used automated money-laundering patterns not seen before; Elliptic: almost all of the $6.3B was taken in the first 30 minutes  —  North Korean hackers' attack on Binance takes crypto theft to an unprecedented scale  —  The largest financial theft in history took no more than 30 minutes.

item.title: Salesforce acquires Rune, which makes AI military logistics software, sources say for $375M in cash and stock; Rune raised $30m from a16z and others (Margaux MacColl/Resilience Media)
item.description:
Margaux MacColl / Resilience Media:
Salesforce acquires Rune, which makes AI military logistics software, sources say for $375M in cash and stock; Rune raised $30m from a16z and others  —  Salesforce is acquiring defence tech startup Rune Technologies for $375 million in a combination of shares and cash, according to two sources familiar with the matter.

Original (direct link): https://resiliencemedia.co/scoop-salesforce-is-paying-375m-for-rune-technologies/
